brief.text: Real Estate Investment Trusts show concentrated interest across the data, with REITs ADC and RWT combining for over $5.38 million in total buys across six insiders. SBLK distinctly stands out among all cluster transactions, where an unusually high count of eight insiders accumulated $6.92 million worth of shares. Meanwhile, the largest single transaction across both tables belongs to 10% owner Nippon Life Insurance Co, which allocated $11.23 million to CRBG—more than double the next largest individual trade from Shen Ching Hang in CV at $5.0 million.
